Predis.ai vs VEXI: Templated AI Posts or Your Own Content?
Predis.ai and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Predis.ai makes ads, videos and social posts from a product link, a prompt or an image [1][2]. Here is how it compares with one app built around your own footage and your own business.

Predis.ai calls itself an AI ad generator: it creates video ads, UGC ads and product ads from a product link, a text prompt or an image, then tracks how each one performed and shows the ads your competitors are running [1]. Its plans also include social posts, carousels, captions and hashtags, and a scheduler that publishes to channels such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, Google Business Profile and X [2]. On its pricing page today, billed yearly, Core is $19 a month ($230 a year) and lists “No Auto Posting”, Rise is $40 a month ($474 a year) with auto posting, and Enterprise+ is $212 a month ($2,540 a year) [2]. Its pricing page says every plan starts with 3 days free [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is focus. Predis.ai is built around ads: making them from a product link, a prompt or an image, then reporting back on which ones earned the click [1][2]. VEXI starts from your own footage, photos and business: you ask, and the post comes back edited, designed, captioned and posted. VEXI costs more than Predis.ai: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.

Does Predis.ai edit my own videos?
Predis.ai's pricing page lists a video editor and uploading your own assets among its features [2]. VEXI edits your footage: cuts, B-roll, music and captions.

Yes, from the Rise plan: Predis.ai's pricing page says its AI generates up to 2 posts a day that can be reviewed before publishing, and the Core plan lists “No Auto Posting” [2]. VEXI posts to your connected accounts on every plan, on a schedule or on Autopilot.
